A former pharmaceutical sales rep tells Rogan, in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience, how OxyContin took over America. The insider account covers the years when the drug was pushed hard on doctors as safe and rare in abuse. The speaker watched the machine from inside.

He describes the sales tactics, the bonuses, and the way doubts were brushed aside as addiction spread. Rogan asks when the reps knew what they were selling. The segment is a grim piece of the opioid story, valuable because it comes from the sales floor rather than from a courtroom or a headline.
